exercises.title: Actual/360 interest calculator
exercises.intro: Work out a month's interest on an interest-only balance, then check it here. Change the inputs afterwards to try your own what-ifs.

calculator.task: Birchwood Plaza, month 18: SOFR is 4.75%, so the note rate is 4.75% + 4.00% = 8.75%. The funded balance is $3,460,000. What is the interest for a 31-day month (F-CORE-01)?

exercises.title: Maple Run billing statement
exercises.intro: Build Maple Run's interest bills for January to June 2027, one period at a time. Each line opens when the one before it is right.

buildup.context: Maple Run (RD-RES-01) closes on 15 Jan 2027 with a $240,000 initial advance at 10.250%, interest only, Actual/360. Draws of $30,000 fund on 15 Mar and $25,000 on 15 May. The funding day counts; the payoff day does not (D-CONV-02). Split a period at each draw, and round each period to the cent once.

lines.label: Per diem on $240,000 (F-CORE-05)
lines.hint: $240,000 × 10.25% ÷ 360. Keep it unrounded when you multiply.

lines.label: 15-31 Jan, prepaid at closing (CORE-CLS-04, F-CORE-33)
lines.hint: 15 to 31 January is 17 days, because the funding day counts. $240,000 × 10.25% ÷ 360 × 17.

lines.label: 1-31 Mar (the $30,000 draw funds on 15 Mar)
lines.hint: 14 days on $240,000, then 17 days on $270,000. Add them, then round once.

lines.label: Six-month total of the rounded rows
lines.hint: Add the six rounded amounts, January included. Those are the amounts charged.

lines.label: February to June bills only
lines.hint: January's $1,161.67 is collected at closing, so take it off the total.

exercises.title: Test versus bill
exercises.intro: Compare the debt service a coverage test uses with the interest actually billed, month by month and for the year.

buildup.context: Cedar Court (RD-MF-01) funds $4,340,000 on day one. The test rate is 8.25%, the higher of the 7.65% note rate and the 4.25% cap strike + 4.00% spread. Tests use the nominal rate; bills use Actual/360 (D-CONV-01). Use 8.25% for both here, so only the day count differs.

lines.label: Test ADS for the coverage test (F-CORE-03, interest only)
One month's share of the test ADS
Gap in the 31-day month: billed minus the test share
Yearly gap: billed minus test ADS
lines.hint: $363,022.92 − $358,050.00. It is 5 ÷ 360 of a year's test interest.
